syllabus_evidence.wording: 200 marks, 100 questions. Includes: History of India and Indian National Movement. Note: 30-35% questions in General Studies Paper I will be related to Assam.

Indian culture (art forms, literature, architecture, ancient to modern); modern Indian history from about the middle of the eighteenth century; the Freedom Struggle, its stages and contributors from different parts of the country; post-independence consolidation. Descriptive paper, outside this course, but it supports the modern weighting.

maps.india_outline: Assam History library, data/maps/boundaries.json, key 'india'. DataMeet Community Maps india-soi.geojson, from Survey of India and Census 2011 geometry. CC BY-SA 2.5 / ODbL, so attribution is required. Use this outline, not Natural Earth, for India's boundary.
maps.others: world.json and neighbours.json are Natural Earth, public domain, for outlines of other countries. Do not take India from them.

pictures: The Assam History library has no Indian-history pictures: a filename search found none. A picture inventory must be built from scratch, with licence and origin per image.
